title: My Dying Sister Gave Me Her Condo, My Nephew Called It Rent. So I Foreclosed And Now He Pays
description: When my dying sister promised me her condo in a notarized letter, my nephew waited until after the funeral to produce a trust that called my $88,000 in care payments 'rent.' I found a secret voicemail, sued for unjust enrichment, and won a $195,000 judgment. Now I rent the condo to traveling nurses while his wages are garnished for emotional damages. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE CALLED MY CARE PAYMENTS RENT. NOW HE PAYS ME.
pinned_comment: If your nephew tried to steal your dying sister’s condo after you spent $88,000 on her care, would you have searched the trash for a hidden voicemail like I did? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: AFTER THE FUNERAL, HE PRODUCED A TRUST AND CALLED MY $88,000 RENT
